description: This file defines a class ByteArray which provides byte array manipulation functionalities, such as encoding, comparison, bitwise operations, slicing, and conversion to string. It is part of the AWS SDK's cryptography library, serving as a utility for handling byte data in cryptographic operations.

classes.name: ByteArray
classes.description: A utility class extending SplFixedArray for byte array operations in cryptographic contexts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ByteArray from an integer, string, array, or another ByteArray.

methods.name: enc32be
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit unsigned integer into a big-endian ByteArray.

methods.name: exclusiveOr
methods.description: Performs a bitwise XOR between two ByteArrays of equal size.

methods.name: getIncremented
methods.description: Returns a new ByteArray incremented by a specified value.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Overrides to set a value at a specific index, ensuring byte overflow is handled.

methods.name: rshift
methods.description: Returns a new ByteArray shifted right by one bit.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Constant-time select between two ByteArrays based on a flag.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets values from another ByteArray within a specified offset.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a slice of the ByteArray.

methods.name: zeroize
methods.description: Sets all bytes in the ByteArray to zero.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the ByteArray to a raw binary string.
